note: An incoming message during an open card attempt is a toast beside the sale, never a modal; the attempt keeps its device and drawer owner.
Row = name or “Visitor”, subject, last message, time, unread, owner, record chips, one next action. The panel shows what the next action needs; history and explanations live behind disclosures.
Both side columns collapse to a rail. Every commerce action (send options, create or link, request payment, attach, note, reminder) lives in one labelled Actions control beside the composer.
Three states, three actions. A failed load keeps typed drafts on the device.
Details from the chat are suggestions until confirmed. A pickup order needs a name and a way to say it is ready; a guest order (name + reference) is allowed, no customer record required.

Linking (internal, shows history to staff) ≠ confirming identity (a known detail or SMS code) ≠ granting the customer access to their records. A phone match and a name-only similarity are different choices.

Re-linking shows the impact first: the conversation moves, the paid order keeps its payment and changes buyer, nothing from this chat stays on the wrong person, and the change is audited with a reason.
Owner = who replies and follows up; it is a permission, not a profession. Who performs the service is chosen on the booking (MS10). Appts & classes
One picker with tabs per family; two exits: send for the customer to choose, or add to the draft. The preview is exactly the customer card: thumbnails, prices in MXN, no cost, margin or notes.
The card shows its own state (sent · viewed · selected). Customer and operator edit one draft (#1203); the panel is the draft. The pickup slot is kept only while the payment link is valid.

Colour 1 h 50 (apply, processing, rinse) + cut 45 min = 2 h 35; Olaplex runs during processing. A shown slot is not a hold: availability is rechecked when Laura picks, and the pick holds Dani, chair 2 and the basin for 15 min. Appts & classes

Eligibility, location, conflicts, resources per phase. Staff need no acceptance step; represented talent accept each assignment under their contract. Preference vs confirmed assignment is explicit. Appts & classes
What is already linked is shown before anything is created. Reservation, catering order and tickets each keep their own payment and capacity; the conversation survives all of them. Tables
Customer content (lines, total, deposit, milestones, validity, cancellation) is one card; internal (fees, margin) is a separate locked card that is never sent. Projects
v2 is current with Remind / Revise / Withdraw; v1 is a collapsed superseded card. Acceptance is the customer’s, on the exact version; “Accepted · awaiting deposit” is not Won. Projects
Same three numbers as the customer card ($1,350 · $405 · $945). Request a secure page or collect at the counter; both settle the same record once. No card is “on file” from a chat. Appts & classes
The card states paid and remaining with the original request. Requested → opened → paid → saved → kitchen is a history, not a status bar.
Each queue has an owner and one action. Closing as lost names the reason and can withdraw the live offer; the customer’s existing records are untouched.

Requested Mon 14 Sep 09:12, 24 h 48 min before the appointment; cutoff Mon 14 Sep 10:00; deposit kept, no fee. What changes for Dani, chair, basin and the original slot is listed before confirming. Appts & classes
Previous, Luis’s saved version and your change side by side with the result of keeping both. Marco chose 19:40, so he must review before paying.

What the operator does depends on what is known: retry a kitchen ticket, recover an order from the saved checkout, check a payment status, or resolve an unavailable slot. None of them requests payment again.
Same ticket id on every retry, so no duplicate. After three failures the order goes to Issues with the payment and ticket attached; the counter can print it.
The payment page is locked to basket v3. A later edit becomes v4; either let v3 complete or cancel the page and send v4 for review. Nothing is silently merged.
Operators can start a WhatsApp, SMS or email conversation; web chat can only be opened by the customer. Without a contact method there is a note on the record, not a message.
Internal mode is visibly different from a reply. Attachments show sent, uploading and failed states on both sides. Appts & classes
Sent, delivered, read and failed per channel; a failed message is kept and retried once; drafts survive a disconnect; new messages below the fold are a pill, not a jump.
A reply after resolution reopens the conversation for the same owner. Handover moves the pending draft and reminders; the customer sees the same thread.
Results show the matching snippet; opening lands on the message; Back returns to the list, then to the thread at the same position.
One scheduled message per record; the row says why it was cancelled (reply, payment, handover) or why it failed (invalid number) and what to do.

Acceptance stands 48 h if the deposit fails; a decline after payment proposes a named replacement the customer must approve; an expired version is revised or closed; a withdraw/accept race resolves to the earlier action. Projects
